verdict.rationale: Daytona's pricing page explicitly offers "$200 in free compute included" with usage-based, self-serve framing ("Use what you need, when you need it"), so included credits are documented. However, no evidence shows that sign-up and the start of building happen without sales contact, and nothing gives the credit terms (expiry, limits, card requirement). missing for 10: explicit self-serve signup/no-sales-contact evidence, documented credit terms and limits (expiry, quotas, card requirement), independent or hands-on corroboration of the free-credit onboarding.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building with a free tier or included credits without talking to sales

citations.quote: Use what you need, when you need it. $200 in free compute included.
Daytona lets you spin up sandboxes in milliseconds and shut them down just as fast. Use what you need, when you need it.
